_about: Third-party skill packs, installed from their own source so licences and updates stay with their authors. `scripts/install-packs.sh <pack> [<pack> ...]` installs them; `--list` shows them. The `core` skills of this kit are vendored in skills/ and installed by install.sh.

design.why: Award-level web design: build from a one-line prompt, score sites like an Awwwards jury, polish UI, design references.

engineering.why: Disciplined software process: brainstorm, plan, TDD, debugging, code review, shipping, QA in a real browser.

security.why: Security auditing: semgrep and CodeQL rules, fuzzing, smart-contract scanners, insecure defaults, variant analysis.

cloudflare.why: Building and deploying on Cloudflare: Workers, Pages, D1, Durable Objects, Wrangler, Turnstile, Zero Trust.

documents.why: Office files and PDFs: create and edit .docx, .pptx, .xlsx and PDF.

items.name: anthropics/skills
items.license: see repo (some skills are source-available, not open source)

claude-mods.why: Live lines above the Claude Code prompt: plan usage (usage-meter) and running workers (agent-radar). The herdr-lead-mods skill reads them.

items.name: hamzafer/claude-code-mods: usage-meter, agent-radar
items.run: claude plugin marketplace add hamzafer/claude-code-mods && claude plugin install usage-meter@claude-code-mods && claude plugin install agent-radar@claude-code-mods

hermes.why: Hermes Agent: an always-on personal agent (messaging, cron jobs, memory) and the easiest no-API-key image backend (`hermes auth codex`, used by tools/codex-image).

items.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
items.run: echo 'Install Hermes by following https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent#installation, then run: hermes auth codex'

not_included.why: Skills that were on the original machines but are not shipped or installed by this kit.
items: Client- and person-specific skills (one client's site, one person's CV, LinkedIn voice or course paperwork).
Jailbreak, model-uncensoring and dark-web access skills: not appropriate to hand out.
antislop: its origin and licence could not be confirmed.
Skills built into an agent (hermes bundled skills, Codex system skills): they arrive with that agent.
